text: SCOPE ADDITION from the orchestrator token audit (round-92): yield-watching is polling too. The audit found the orchestrator holding write_stdin yields (yield_time_ms:30000, five+ consecutive cycles with progress narration between: '700/912 crates... 880/912...') on a cold build — same violation class as get-text loops, different API shape. The detector must count write_stdin calls with yield_time_ms above ~5s against the same threshold as pane get-text/status polls.
